channel.title: The New Stack – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The New Stack – Bias and Credibility (thenewstack.io)

item.title: How to deploy Pi-Hole with Docker and stop ads on every device on your LAN
item.description: Pi-Hole is an open source, network-wide ad blocker. Learn to deploy it as a Docker container to protect every device on your LAN from ads and trackers.

item.title: Four prompt engineering patterns every developer should know — and why "draw a cat" explains them all
item.description: If your AI outputs keep missing the mark, the model probably isn't the problem — here's how to write prompts that reduce variance and get reliable results.

item.title: Minimus aims to solve one of open-source's long-festering problems
item.description: Minimus launches a free, open-source program offering hardened container images, SBOM tools, and threat intelligence to help maintainers secure their supply chains.

item.title: Exton Linux's light version will "enlighten" you
item.description: A Debian 13-based distro built around the Enlightenment desktop brings old-school Linux efficiency into the modern era — and it's fast enough to make you forget you ever left.

item.title: PwC's AI agents are now your consultants -- whether you're ready or not
item.description: PwC's new agentic platform cuts consultants out of the loop as first responders. What that means for pricing and liability remains an open question.

item.title: Kubernetes co-founder Brendan Burns: AI-generated code will become as invisible as assembly
item.description: Burns argues that as testing frameworks mature, developers will stop reviewing most code and programming languages will evolve to match.

item.title: IBM, Red Hat, and Google just donated a Kubernetes blueprint for LLM inference to the CNCF
item.description: IBM, Red Hat & Google donate llm-d to CNCF — an open-source Kubernetes framework for scalable, vendor-neutral LLM inference on any model, accelerator, or cloud.

item.title: Broadcom donates Velero to CNCF — and it could reshape how Kubernetes users handle backup and disaster recovery
item.description: Broadcom VMware donates Velero to CNCF sandbox, expands VKS 3.6 with open-source integrations, new CNI options, and QD profiles for AI and database workloads.

item.title: WebAssembly could solve AI agents' most dangerous security gap
item.description: WebAssembly offers strong isolation and sandboxing for AI agent-generated code, solving security risks that containers and microVMs struggle to address.

item.title: Ai2 launches MolmoWeb, an open-source web agent
item.description: The open-source web agent ships with the full training stack and was built without distilling from proprietary models.
